prompt:
Add a `tasklist` extension: a list item whose text starts with `[ ]`, `[x]` or `[X]` followed by a space becomes a task.
- The marker is replaced by `<input type="checkbox">`, `checked` for `x`/`X`, and `disabled` unless the `clickable` option is true (default false).
- The `<li>` gets the class from the `item_class` option (default `task`).
- It works in ordered and unordered lists, nested lists and loose lists, and keeps inline markup after the marker.
Register it so `markdown.Markdown(extensions=['tasklist'])` works once installed.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

+# Task List Extension for Python-Markdown
+# =======================================
+
+# Converts list items starting with `[ ]`, `[x]`, or `[X]` into task items.
+
+# See https://Python-Markdown.github.io/extensions/tasklist
+# for documentation.
+
+# Copyright The Python Markdown Project
+
+# License: [BSD](https://opensource.org/licenses/bsd-license.php)
+
+"""
+Converts list items starting with `[ ]`, `[x]`, or `[X]` into task items.
+
+See the [documentation](https://Python-Markdown.github.io/extensions/tasklist)
+for details.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from . import Extension
+from ..treeprocessors import Treeprocessor
+import re
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as etree
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:  # pragma: no cover
+    from markdown import Markdown
+
+
+class TasklistTreeprocessor(Treeprocessor):
+    """ Replace task list markers with checkbox `<input>` elements. """
+
+    RE = re.compile(r'^\[([ xX])\] ')
+
+    def __init__(self, md: Markdown, config: dict[str, Any]):
+        super().__init__(md)
+        self.item_class: str = config['item_class']
+        self.clickable: bool = bool(config['clickable'])
+
+    def run(self, root: etree.Element) -> None:
+        for li in root.iter('li'):
+            if li.text and li.text.strip():
+                target = li
+            elif len(li) and li[0].tag == 'p':
+                target = li[0]
+            else:
+                continue
+
+            if target.text and (m := self.RE.match(target.text)):
+                if self.item_class:
+                    cls = li.get('class')
+                    li.set('class', f'{cls} {self.item_class}' if cls else self.item_class)
+                checkbox = etree.Element('input', {'type': 'checkbox'})
+                if m.group(1) != ' ':
+                    checkbox.set('checked', 'checked')
+                if not self.clickable:
+                    checkbox.set('disabled', 'disabled')
+                checkbox.tail = target.text[3:]
+                target.text = None
+                target.insert(0, checkbox)
+
+
+class TasklistExtension(Extension):
+    """ Task List extension for Python-Markdown. """
+
+    TreeProcessorClass = TasklistTreeprocessor
+
+    def __init__(self, **kwargs: Any):
+        self.config = {
+            'item_class': [
+                'task',
+                'CSS class to add to task list `<li>` elements. Default: `task`.'
+            ],
+            'clickable': [
+                False,
+                'If `True`, omit `disabled` attribute on checkbox `<input>`. Default: `False`.'
+            ],
+        }
+        """ Default configuration options. """
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)
+
+    def extendMarkdown(self, md: Markdown) -> None:
+        """ Register the processor.
+
+        | Class Instance                                                             | Registry                                                         | Name       | Priority |
+        | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | :------: |
+        | [`TasklistTreeprocessor`][markdown.extensions.tasklist.TasklistTreeprocessor] | [`treeprocessors`][markdown.treeprocessors.build_treeprocessors] | `tasklist` | `25`     |
+
+        """
+        # flake8: noqa: E501 86-88
+        tasklist = self.TreeProcessorClass(md, self.getConfigs())
+        md.treeprocessors.register(tasklist, 'tasklist', 25)
+
+
+TaskListTreeprocessor = TasklistTreeprocessor
+TaskListExtension = TasklistExtension
+
+
+def makeExtension(**kwargs: Any) -> TasklistExtension:  # pragma: no cover
+    return TasklistExtension(**kwargs)
